title: Eternal Loop at World's End
description: A surreal fantasy landscape features a glowing orange infinity dragon with a bald purple-skinned woman on the left and a black horned demon with glowing pink eyes on the right, their bodies forming an infinity symbol. In the foreground a wooden sign reads 'THE END' on a cliff edge, while above float an astronaut, a red-cloaked figure, a castle on a mountain peak, and a starry cosmic sky with swirling galaxies.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with a glowing orange infinity dragon whose body forms a loop, a bald purple-skinned woman with yellow eyes on the left side and a black horned demon with glowing pink eyes on the right side, both emerging from the dragon. A wooden sign in the foreground reads 'THE END' on a grassy cliff. In the background are snow-capped mountains, a medieval castle, a floating astronaut in a blue suit, a small red-cloaked figure standing on the dragon, a winding river through a pine valley, and a starry purple cosmic sky with galaxies and nebulae.
